title: Bulk-boundary correspondence from hyper-invariant tensor networks
abstract: Introduces a tensor network framework designed to simulate the AdS/CFT correspondence. The construction integrates bulk indices within the network architecture to uphold key features of the HaPPY code, including complementary recovery. Successfully reproduces boundary CFT two-point and three-point correlation functions. Considers the image of any bulk operator. Published in Physical Review D 111, 026006 (2025).
key_claims: Hyper-invariant tensor network simulates AdS/CFT correspondence
Reproduces boundary CFT two-point and three-point correlation functions
Integrates bulk indices while maintaining HaPPY code features
Provides explicit methods for efficient correlation function calculations
